Past continuous · 基础巩固(第3轮): The past continuous depicts what was happening at a certain past time.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。
was + V-ing (I/he/she/it)|were + V-ing (you/we/they)|often with at that time, at eight last night|the negative is was/were not + V-ing|the question moves was/were before the subject
I was reading at nine last night.

column4: 考查was/were + V-ing indicates an action in progress at a past moment。此处应为 was reading。句意:昨晚九点我正在读书。
